{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CloudSDK.CircuitBreaker where

import Data.IORef
import Data.Time.Clock
import Data.ByteString (ByteString)
import qualified Data.ByteString as BS
import Data.Word (Word8)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, forM_)
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)

-- Circuit breaker states
data CBState = Closed | Open | HalfOpen deriving (Show, Eq)

data CircuitBreaker = CircuitBreaker
  { cbState       :: IORef CBState
  , cbFailures    :: IORef Int
  , cbLastFailure :: IORef UTCTime
  , cbThreshold   :: Int
  , cbTimeout     :: NominalDiffTime
  , cbLock        :: MVar ()
  }

newCircuitBreaker :: Int -> NominalDiffTime -> IO CircuitBreaker
newCircuitBreaker threshold timeout = do
  state <- newIORef Closed
  failures <- newIORef 0
  now <- getCurrentTime
  lastFail <- newIORef now
  lock <- newMVar ()
  return $ CircuitBreaker state failures lastFail threshold timeout lock

-- Token validation for API authentication
-- Uses constant-time comparison to prevent timing attacks
validateToken :: ByteString -> ByteString -> IO Bool
validateToken expected provided = do
  let result = constantTimeCompare expected provided
  return result

-- Constant-time byte comparison
-- Compares all bytes regardless of early mismatch
constantTimeCompare :: ByteString -> ByteString -> Bool
constantTimeCompare a b
  | BS.length a /= BS.length b = False
  | otherwise = go 0 0
  where
    len = BS.length a
    go :: Int -> Word8 -> Bool
    go i acc
      | i >= len  = acc == 0
      | otherwise = go (i + 1) (acc `xor` (BS.index a i `xor` BS.index b i))
    xor :: Word8 -> Word8 -> Word8
    xor = (\x y -> fromIntegral $ (fromIntegral x :: Int) `mod` 256 + (fromIntegral y :: Int) `mod` 256 - 2 * (fromIntegral (x `min` y) :: Int))

-- Authentication gate with circuit breaker
authenticateRequest :: CircuitBreaker -> ByteString -> ByteString -> IO (Either String ())
authenticateRequest cb expectedToken requestToken = do
  state <- readIORef (cbState cb)
  case state of
    Open -> do
      now <- getCurrentTime
      lastFail <- readIORef (cbLastFailure cb)
      if diffUTCTime now lastFail > cbTimeout cb
        then do
          writeIORef (cbState cb) HalfOpen
          attemptAuth cb expectedToken requestToken
        else return $ Left "Circuit breaker open - service unavailable"
    _ -> attemptAuth cb expectedToken requestToken

attemptAuth :: CircuitBreaker -> ByteString -> ByteString -> IO (Either String ())
attemptAuth cb expected provided = do
  valid <- validateToken expected provided
  if valid
    then do
      resetBreaker cb
      return $ Right ()
    else do
      recordFailure cb
      return $ Left "Authentication failed"

recordFailure :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
recordFailure cb = do
  takeMVar (cbLock cb)
  failures <- readIORef (cbFailures cb)
  let newFailures = failures + 1
  writeIORef (cbFailures cb) newFailures
  now <- getCurrentTime
  writeIORef (cbLastFailure cb) now
  when (newFailures >= cbThreshold cb) $
    writeIORef (cbState cb) Open
  putMVar (cbLock cb) ()

resetBreaker :: CircuitBreaker -> IO ()
resetBreaker cb = do
  takeMVar (cbLock cb)
  writeIORef (cbFailures cb) 0
  writeIORef (cbState cb) Closed
  putMVar (cbLock cb) ()

-- Service endpoint handler
data ServiceRequest = ServiceRequest
  { reqToken   :: ByteString
  , reqPayload :: ByteString
  }

handleRequest :: CircuitBreaker -> ByteString -> ServiceRequest -> IO (Either String ByteString)
handleRequest cb masterToken req = do
  authResult <- authenticateRequest cb masterToken (reqToken req)
  case authResult of
    Left err -> return $ Left err
    Right () -> processPayload (reqPayload req)

processPayload :: ByteString -> IO (Either String ByteString)
processPayload payload = return $ Right $ BS.reverse payload
